use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum AppError {
    #[error(transparent)]
    ParseConfig {
        context: String,
        line: u32,
        #[from]
        err: serde_json::Error,
    },

    #[error(transparent)]
    ReadFile {
        path: String,
        #[from]
        err: std::io::Error,
    },

    #[error(transparent)]
    QueryUser {
        user_id: u64,
        #[from]
        err: sqlx::Error,
    },
}

fn load_config() -> Result<Config, AppError> {
    let data = std::fs::read_to_string("config.json").map_err(|e| AppError::ReadFile {
        path: "config.json".into(),
        err: e,
    })?;
    let config: Config = serde_json::from_str(&data).map_err(|e| AppError::ParseConfig {
        context: "Failed to parse config.json".into(),
        line: 0,
        err: e,
    })?;
    Ok(config)
}

struct Config;
